name: elf_packed_miner
description: A static x86-64 ELF program holding its miner strings only compressed behind UPX markers, as packed miners ship, in a hidden directory. No replayed path flags it, and at start YARA finds nothing either: docroot_binary_exec reports it only as a Warning when a PHP interpreter starts it.
provenance: written for the corpus with the buildTestELF layout of internal/yara/elf_web_dropper_test.go

realtime.gap: the write path only tracks an executable for self-deletion; realtime reads a program when it starts (docroot_binary_exec), which no driver replays, and YARA finds nothing in this packed one

tier.gap: YARA matches miner strings in clear text only and no rule or check flags a packed ELF program

fullscan.gap: YARA matches miner strings in clear text only and no rule or check flags a packed ELF program
